feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: John Turturro says he likes trying new things (even pickpocketing)
entry.summary: Lifting wallets was part of Turturro's training for the film The Only Living Pickpocket in New York. In it, he plays a small-time thief who's also the primary caretaker for his ailing wife.

entry.title: DOJ asks for Supreme Court to intervene on California ballot demands
entry.summary: On the eve of the Nov. 3 election, the Trump administration is hoping the Supreme Court will reverse lower courts that rejected its request to order California to set aside the ballots of thousands of people it says are "likely" noncitizens.

entry.title: Two economists studied California's billionaire tax. They reached wildly different conclusions
entry.summary: What happens in California could shape how America taxes the superrich. But will its billionaire tax fill state coffers — or drain them?

entry.title: 6 things to watch for on election night
entry.summary: Some of the key storylines to watch will center around various voters groups that have soured on President Trump during his second turn out.

entry.title: When it comes to election pressure, this year's Georgia or Michigan could be anywhere
entry.summary: The districts that will decide control of the House and Senate next year are spread across the country. Voting officials in those places may face scrutiny and pressure they've never experienced.

entry.title: With students scarce, college admissions offices get friendlier, less intimidating
entry.summary: Colleges are trying to transform an admissions process that has often been daunting, secretive and stressful into an experience that's open, easier — and downright friendly.

entry.title: How does this fluoride-free toothpaste compare when it comes to oral health?
entry.summary: Many people are swapping out their fluoride dental products for ones made with a mineral called hydroxyapatite. What do dentists say about it?

entry.title: What Vance's midterm push reveals about his potential 2028 bid
entry.summary: Vance's delivery is different from the president's but his speeches contain plenty of MAGA DNA.

entry.title: UN's peacekeeping mission in disputed Western Sahara ends after 35 years
entry.summary: The U.N.'s long-running peacekeeping mission for the disputed Western Sahara ceased operations Sunday after 35 years. Once ruled by Spain, it is claimed by both Morocco and the pro-independence Polisario Front.

entry.title: 9 dead as jet nosedives and erupts into fireball near busy roadway in South Florida
entry.summary: U.S. Transportation Secretary Duffy says all nine people died aboard a business jet that crashed into a Florida neighborhood. The aircraft departed from Austin, Texas, and was headed to the Bahamas.
